episodes.title: Beginnings
episodes.summary: Tim was a broken-hearted skateboarder, Daisy a directionless, wannabe journalist. Fate kicked them onto the streets to meet for the first time in a greasy spoon.

episodes.title: Gatherings
episodes.summary: Having finally tackled the task of unpacking and faced with the prospect of having to do some work, Daisy persuades Tim to have a house-warming party.

episodes.title: Art
episodes.summary: Daisy's world is rocked by the prospect of employment, Brian is shaken by the appearance of a bizarre figure from his theatrical past, and Tim is plagued by the living dead.

episodes.title: Battles
episodes.summary: Daisy receives some bad news from her boyfriend and decides to brighten up her life by getting a dog. Meanwhile, Tim goes paint-balling with his arch-enemy.

episodes.title: Chaos
episodes.summary: Daisy and her new dog are falling in love - which makes Tim jealous. But then events take a sinister turn when the dog is kidnapped by an evil vivisectionist.

episodes.title: Epiphanies
episodes.summary: Tensions are running high. Tim and Daisy are bickering and Mike is facing rejection from his rambling club. Can a night of hedonism sort everything out? It seems worth a try...

episodes.title: Ends
episodes.summary: Daisy and Tim's domestic bliss is threatened when Tim's ex-girlfriend wants to get back together with him.

episodes.title: Back
episodes.summary: Daisy returns from a trip to Asia pursued by a sinister government agency. To make matters worse, Tim seems to have found himself a new flatmate.

episodes.title: Change
episodes.summary: Tim is fired after taking his diappointment in The Phantom Menace out on a young customer. Meanwhile, Daisy struggles to claim her dole money from the job centre.

episodes.title: Mettle
episodes.summary: Sinister sabotage seriously threatens Mike and Tim's chances of winning Robot Wars, while Daisy gets a job in Hell's Kitchen and Brian faces the terrifying prospect of an exhibition.

episodes.title: Help
episodes.summary: Tim faces a race against time when Daisy accidentally jeopardises his career. Elsewhere, Daisy and Marsha decide to get fit, and Brian decides to tell his mother the truth about his chosen career.

episodes.title: Gone
episodes.summary: A night on the town for Tim and Daisy turns into a fight for survival as the dynamic duo come face to face with an old enemy (not to mention a few new ones).

episodes.title: Dissolution
episodes.summary: It's Daisy's birthday but all is not well at 23 Meteor Street. The survival of the group is threatened when Marsha begins to suspect things between Daisy and Tim are not what they seem...

episodes.title: Leaves
episodes.summary: With Marsha gone and the house up for sale, Daisy and Tim hatch a plan to save themselves and their friends from oblivion. However, has Daisy had enough? And does Tim really care?
